Requires an authoritative finite invoice balance of exactly zero and no linked uncleared checks, Zelle, deposits or card receipts. Negative credit balances require accounting resolution. Null/invalid balances fail closed; an omitted balance is accepted only when cost is present and finite cost minus discount minus payment equals exactly zero. No uncleared-payment override is supported. Returns 409 otherwise. Payments are separate and are never reversed by delivery failure or cancellation.
Requires canUpdateDelivery or canUpdateAssignedDeliveries plus invoice update; assigned-only grants require crew membership for every piece in this invoice/delivery. Select 1–200 unique status ID 6 items using barcodeIds (ObjectIDs) or legacyBarcodeIds (positive numeric IDs for invoice-embedded pieces without barcodeId) belonging to this invoice/delivery and optionally up to 12 uploaded invoice image document IDs created by this collector. The API associates the photos, appends the private signature with server date/collector, changes only selected embedded/catalog pieces to status ID 7 (currently ENTREGADO) and writes audit in one transaction. Unselected pieces remain status ID 6 for another trip. Active policy IDs and agreement must match. Reuse the UUID requestId with the exact same payload for safe retries; changing its payload returns 409. No signature data is returned. Upload photos first via the existing invoice document endpoint; failed completion leaves those photos stored for retry.

Other deliveries and ENTREGADO items are excluded.

put.description: Requires delivery update permission: canUpdateDelivery or canUpdateAssignedDeliveries; assigned-only grants require crew membership for every piece in this invoice/delivery. The invoice must have barcodes assigned to this delivery and share its container in the current tenant. The delivery ID is the barcode delivery.id, not route.id; optional body deliveryId must match the delivery path ID. Supply the actual signer name, PNG/JPEG base64 data (up to 2 MiB decoded), contentType and idNumber inside receiverSignature; the actual signer may differ from the invoice receiver. API sets signedAt and collectedBy. Each distinct receipt is appended with a server-generated signature ID and delivery ID; repeating identical data for that delivery preserves the original receipt. No invoice customer ID, financial totals, barcode status, or delivery status is changed. Returns only invoiceId/deliveryId; signature data is write-only. Prints the receipt signature, date and submitted ID only on this invoice's Recibido por line.

Ledger entries are recorded independently of internal reconciliation. Server recording time and the authenticated user location select the latest closeout. Employee financial responsibility is independent of route attribution; route-attributed finances belong to the captured supervisor. Response data is PostEntryResult with current statement totals. Optional autoClear (default false) is the compatibility alias for internal auto-reconciliation for every transaction/method and requires explicit canReconcileJournal. It never verifies bank settlement. Otherwise the journal is OUTSTANDING. ReconciledAt is API approval time, independent of journal date. Journal PUT cannot change reconciliation fields. Later approval uses POST /journals/reconcile; method-directory clearing is retired. EXPENSE uses sourceAccount: cash defaults to CASH ON HAND; non-cash requires a BANK source, and CHECK requires paymentReference or checkNumber. post.description: Requires route create permission. Creates a new vehicle route unless date, vehicle, and the exact employee set match another dated route (409). Employee order does not distinguish duplicates. Create and edit enforce this rule. Use this endpoint when adding entries, including another delivery conduce for the same container on the same date; do not use PUT for new conduces. Crew templates are creation shortcuts only; no crew reference is stored. A date, vehicle, active employees, one supervisor and one driver are required; supervisor and driver may be the same employee. Helpers cannot hold another role. Names are read-only and generated as YYYY-MM-DD_Vehicle_Supervisor+Driver+Helpers.
